text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
W-What's happening...? Power is surging 
through me, my body feels burning hot...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
O Three Goddesses, while I do not know if 
you were truly the ones who pushed me 
forward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I will never let it go to waste. I'll 
continue giving it my all...!
